rule_text: truth-1 (design_docs/planned/r1/starmap-single-truth-sprint.md): Gaia EDR3 first, distance 1/plx everywhere; where CNS5 evaluated a star's EDR3 solution its adopted value stands (EDR3 zero-point corrected, or Hipparcos vL07 / Gaia DR2 where CNS5 rejected EDR3); a CNS5 star without a Gaia id that GCNS identifies takes EDR3 when plx/e >= 10 and RUWE < 1.4; companions at their system's distance; disagreement over max(3 sigma, 1%) is resolved in the audit
